en.headline: Ethnic minority care teams have reached more than 18,000 households
en.dek: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said the teams, operating from ten support service centres, have delivered real impact through home visits and emergency support over the past two years.
body: Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki said on Sunday that Ethnic Minority Care Teams have contacted more than 18,000 households in just over two years, describing the outcome as real impact.

Speaking at the Carnival of Care and Harmony organised by the Home Affairs Department, he noted that ten Support Service Centres for Ethnic Minorities now operate across districts with larger non-Chinese communities. Each centre hosts a care team led by a social worker and supported by programme workers and volunteers familiar with the languages and cultures of the communities they serve.

The teams conduct proactive home visits and community outreach, help residents with daily challenges and provide timely assistance during emergencies such as typhoons by sharing weather updates, accompanying people to temporary shelters and checking on elderly residents living alone.

Chan added that Youth Networks and Women’s Networks established at the centres organise career training, Mainland exchange tours and other activities to help ethnic minority young people and women build social connections and deepen understanding of national history and culture.

zh.headline: 少數族裔關愛隊兩年多接觸逾1.8萬戶家庭
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，關愛隊由十間支援服務中心營運，透過家訪及緊急支援發揮實質作用。
body: 政務司司長陳國基於周日表示，少數族裔關愛隊在短短兩年多已接觸超過1.8萬個少數族裔家庭，形容這是實質成果。
他在民政事務總署舉辦的「關愛共融嘉年華」上致辭時指出，全港現有十間少數族裔人士支援服務中心，分布於少數族裔社群較集中的地區。每間中心均設有關愛隊，由社工帶領，並有熟悉相關語言文化的活動幹事及義工支援。
關愛隊主動上門探訪及進行社區外展，協助處理日常困難，並在颱風等緊急情況時透過社群網絡發放天氣資訊、陪同有需要人士前往臨時庇護中心，以及關心獨居長者。
陳國基又提到，各中心已成立「青年網絡」及「婦女網絡」，舉辦職涯訓練、內地交流團等活動，協助少數族裔青年及婦女建立社交聯繫，並加深對國家歷史文化的認識。
